LESSON: READING 10.4.1 CHARACTERS AND THEIR TRAITS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.4: Reading 10.4.1 Characters and their traits
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 10.4.1 Characters and their traits, part of Strand 10 in Grade 7 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: What is the relevance of oral narratives in modern society?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. describe a monster/ ogre,

2. search online and offline for features of monster narratives,

3. narrate monster narratives from their immediate environment to their peers,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. describe a monster/ ogre,
2. search online and offline for features of monster narratives,
3. narrate monster narratives from their immediate environment to their peers,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 10.4.1 Characters and their traits together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem solving: It is enhanced as the learner discusses the lessons learned and the relevance of

monster narratives in real life.

• Learning to learn: It is enhanced as the learner seeks support from resource persons on how to relate monsters to real life.

Values:
Patriotism is enhanced since the learner becomes conscious of their moral duties upon relating monster narratives to real life.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Social awareness is enhanced when the learner relates monsters to real life.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the concept of characters and their traits to their learning of literary texts in Kiswahili.
